answer: Each identity must finish a fresh sequential delay proof every epoch: 10 minutes of single-thread work no machine can split or parallelise. The proof is bound to the identity key, so one machine keeps only one violet ember burning per window, while a grove of fakes needs a grove of machines. Running 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 4,000 POA = 4,000,000 POA per epoch; an honest agent pays 4,000 POA once. Missing two in a row burns the last fee and suspends the trading slot for 10 epochs. Limitation: a wealthy attacker can still buy racks of hardware, so this prices sybils up instead of removing them.
